decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (LP/01 and J/373/03 received on 26/08/2016. J/373/01 A and J/373/02 A received on 18/10/2016.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces, excluding the roof, of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The carrying out of repairs, maintenance, MOT testing or other works to any vehicle, or the storage of vehicles or of parts, shall not take place outside of the buildings.

Condition : 5 - The permitted use of Mot testing and vehicle repairs shall not be carried on outside the following times 9.00-18.00 Monday to Saturday, and shall not be carried out on Sundays or public holidays.

Condition : 6 - MOT Testing and the carrying out of repairs and maintenance of vehicles shall not be carried out in any area other than as specified on the approved plan J/373/01 A received on 18/10/2016.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension to an existing MOT workshop
